name: Melancholic Star
source:
There was a city called Suspiria,  in an island with a name long forgotten 
And there was a Princess in a tower
And a Demon in a well
The world was ending
Tragedy fragmented it, blending dreams and reality

But, How much of a difference does it make when both feel like nightmares?

[From [url=https://taumilicorice.itch.io/melancholic-star]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个名字早已被遗忘的岛屿上，有一座名叫“Suspiria”的城市 
塔里有一位公主
还有井里的恶魔
世界即将结束
悲剧将其支离破碎，梦想与现实交融

但是，当两者都感觉像噩梦时，会有多大的区别呢？

[来自[url=https://taumilicorice.itch.io/melancholic-star]itch.io[/url]]
